review_locator: PMCID:PMC12802677, The NLRP3 inflammasome in ischemic stroke; PMCID:PMC10973033, Th17 Cells and IL-17A in Ischemic Stroke
primary_title: Interleukin-1 Mediates Ischemic Brain Injury via Induction of IL-17A in gamma-delta T Cells and CXCL1 in Astrocytes
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-1 and IL-17/TNF cooperation as an astrocyte CXCL1 route; the cited primary shows IL-1beta-induced Cxcl1 expression in cultured and acutely isolated mouse astrocytes after ischemic stroke.
limitations_preserved: Expression-supported astrocyte output; preserve IL-1alpha/beta and ischemic-stroke context, distinguish Cxcl1 transcript from secreted CXCL1, and do not infer a specific TF or traumatic-SCI weighting.

primary_title: Interleukin-1 Mediates Ischemic Brain Injury via Induction of IL-17A in gamma-delta T Cells and CXCL1 in Astrocytes
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-1 and IL-17/TNF cooperation as an astrocyte CXCL1 route; the cited primary shows IL-1beta is a potent inducer of CXCL1 protein in primary astrocyte supernatants and links astrocytic CXCL1 to neutrophil recruitment after ischemic stroke.
limitations_preserved: Extracellular chemokine output only; preserve mouse astrocyte/ischemic-stroke context, keep CXCL1 release distinct from Cxcl1 transcription and later CXCR2 activation, and do not infer traumatic-SCI weighting.
